warnings: The ST-02 plan prints its own chains against grid 3 and rows B/C (1.800 / 0.550 + 1.250 on x, 4.000 / 2.850 + 1.150 on y) — those ticks are lines in the grid master. Section A/B run and rise chains are member detail and stay here.
ST-02: 16 numbered risers on the plan; section A lands on B1 at the bottom and B5 at the top; '0.22' printed perpendicular to the soffit is read as the waist thickness.
Step sections are titled ST-1 / ST-3 here and marked ST-01 / ST-03 on the S-02 plan — kept as printed; each names the beam it lands on (B2 / B1), matching the plan positions.
